formal.title: 合法点号MCP名称的项目开关写出嵌套对象，导致后续配置读取失败
formal.trigger: Existing ordinary current-version settings with a configured server named team.docs; use project capability on/off after ordinary target resolution and a successful settings write.
formal.actual: setOverride joins an opaque server token into capabilityOverrides.mcp.team.docs. saveProjectSetting splits dots and persists {mcp:{team:{docs:"off"}}}; merge retains team as an object, but CapabilityOverridesSchema.mcp requires every record value to be inherit/on/off. getForScope then throws, and ordinary Desktop makeService settings.get/load can reject the merged project configuration.
formal.expected: Persist the entire MCP server name as one literal record key; the produced settings must satisfy the same schema used by readback.
formal.impact: A supported name and normal project switch can leave the project settings unreadable through validated settings APIs until the malformed override is corrected. More than a silently ignored override.
conditions: Successful project settings mutation, normal current config version (2), and no higher layer explicitly removes this subtree.
Global MCP enable uses a whole record and is outside this defect. No claim that every migration/version/consumer fails.
evidence: Root159 ordinary UI -> preload -> IPC -> Desktop service -> core write chain selected source
Independent161 parser/sanitize, merge, schema, ordinary load and version-migration counterchecks
